entities.name: Lily Emberseed
entities.description: Legendary mousefolk of Bloomburrow, champion of the Order of the Holly Leaf, who gained the Seed Flame and fought Wildsear.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: Order of which Lily was a mousefolk champion.

entities.name: Valley
entities.description: Mousefolk settlement of Bloomburrow where Lily was born in the tunnels beneath.

entities.name: War of Cinders
entities.description: War during which Lily was born.

entities.name: Wildsear
entities.description: Calamity Beast, also called the Wildfire Wolf, fought by Lily.

entities.name: Seed Flame
entities.description: Power, also called the Ember Seed, that ignited in Lily's soul.

entities.name: Cragflame
entities.description: Magical sword Lily fashioned from Wildsear's tooth.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: Lily's descendant who later wielded Cragflame to protect Valley.

entities.name: Brambles
entities.description: Region outside Valley where Wildsear was sent and Lily later travelled.

events.summary: Lily faces the Calamity Beast Wildsear and the Seed Flame ignites in her soul, turning her into a radiant sun.
events.quote: the Seed Flame, also called the Ember Seed, ignited in her soul

events.summary: In the war's final battle Lily fights Wildsear, chipping its tooth and sending it beyond the Brambles.
events.quote: she fought Wildsear, chipping its tooth and sending the beast beyond the Brambles

events.summary: Lily fashions the tooth into the sword Cragflame.
events.quote: Lily fashioned the Wildfire Wolf's tooth into the magical sword Cragflame .

events.summary: After the war Lily leaves Valley to travel the Brambles, leaving her armor and sword to her descendants.
events.quote: Lily left Valley to travel the Brambles, leaving her armor and sword to her descendants.

relations.note: She fought and drove back the Calamity Beast.
relations.quote: she fought Wildsear, chipping its tooth

relations.note: She fashioned it from Wildsear's tooth.
relations.quote: Lily fashioned the Wildfire Wolf's tooth into the magical sword Cragflame .
Her descendant Mabel later wielded the blade to protect Valley from the Calamity Beasts.

rejected.note: She was a champion of the order.
rejected.quote: Lily was a mousefolk champion of the Order of the Holly Leaf .
